summary: Cavite 8th District representative with 36 principal-authored bills. Authored free breast cancer screening and treatment, early retirement for health personnel and a lower optional retirement age for government workers, bank-account inquiry in legislative corruption investigations, Comelec field-office manpower, hazard pay for judges and more Court of Appeals divisions.
caveat: Two-issue scores from bill titles only. Judiciary bills (hazard pay, new divisions) are administrative and not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free breast cancer screening and treatment (-2) and earlier retirement for health personnel and government workers (-1). Net slightly left; two issues, bill-based.
